title: Item
description: One question/stimulus. Discriminated by `type` into mcq | numeric | sequence | generated (Dart: sealed class Item with McqItem, NumericItem, SequenceItem, GeneratedItem).

ItemBase.description: Fields every item carries, whatever its type.

lang.description: Language of the stimulus. Defaults to the family's `lang` (fr for most families, en for the English test).

Origin.description: Present only on items materialised at runtime by a generator (never in bank files). Lets an Attempt be replayed: same generatorId + seed => same item.

GeneratorId.description: Key of an ItemGenerator in the engine registry (US-020). Snake_case.

Explanation.description: Shown in practice mode after the answer. Must teach the METHOD, not only restate the answer. FR mandatory, EN optional. Markdown allowed (inline formulas with $...$).

Stem.description: The question text. Markdown allowed (bold, inline code, $formula$). Keep it short: the real test is speeded.

Option.description: One MCQ choice: text and/or media (figure options for logic/spatial items).

media.description: Optional figure/audio displayed with the stem.

passageId.description: Reading comprehension: id of a Passage declared in the same bank file. Items sharing a passageId are presented together, in file order.

correctIndex.description: 0-based index into `options`. The validator checks it is < options.length.

shuffleOptions.description: Set false when option order matters ('none of the above', ordered values).

expected.description: The correct value. For inputFormat `time` it is a number of minutes.

tolerance.description: Accepted deviation. Omitted => exact match (after rounding to `decimals`).

value.description: absolute: same unit as `expected`; relative: fraction (0.02 = 2 %).

unit.description: Displayed after the input field: kt, NM, ft, km/h, L, min... Not localised (aviation units are universal).

inputFormat.description: Drives the keypad (US-022): integer hides '.', time shows hh:mm entry.

decimals.description: User input is rounded to this many decimals before comparison.

SequenceItem.description: Memory stimulus: elements shown one at a time (or as a grid pattern), then recalled.

instructions.description: Shown before the sequence starts. Optional: the engine has a default per recallMode.

stimulusKind.description: digits/letters: single characters. symbols: keys of the engine's symbol set (circle, square, triangle, star, cross, diamond). colors: red|blue|green|yellow|orange|purple. gridCells: 'row,col' zero-based, requires `grid`.

presentationMs.description: Display time of each element (or of the whole pattern for gridCells).

recallMode.description: forward: repeat in order. backward: reverse order. anyOrder: set equality (used for grid patterns).

explanation.description: Optional for sequences: a chunking/rehearsal tip.

GeneratedItem.description: A reproducible recipe: the engine calls generator `generatorId` with `seed` and `params` and obtains a concrete mcq/numeric/sequence item (carrying `origin`). Used for hand-picked seeds in banks and for worked examples; blueprints use ExamSection.itemSelection instead.

params.description: Generator-specific parameters, documented by each engine story (US-023..029). Unknown keys are ignored by the generator. Never carry the answer here.

Passage.description: Shared reading text for a group of MCQ items (English reading, verbal comprehension).

body.description: Markdown. 80-250 words for PSY0 English reading.
